summary: A group of people in your organisation who own and carry out work. Teams sit under other teams, as on an org chart.
example: Depot Network Team, which sits under the Operations Team.
definition: A team is a group in your organisation's structure. Teams sit under other teams, as on an org chart. Projects, operations and data sources each name the team whose work they are, and a programme names a lead team and supporting teams. A person can edit the work of their own teams and the teams under them. Use the structure your organisation already has; you can bring teams in from your directory's groups. A team is not a person and does not list people. It is not a role (such as a sponsor or service owner), not a group of people your work serves, and not a project, programme or operation.
